changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookmarks ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, sport VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'NFL', full_reference VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE KEY unique_user_bookmark (user_id, sport, full_reference) );
